url.query: FROM logs-* | WHERE service.name IN ("vincari-portal", "vincari-telehealth", "vincari-fhir", "vincari-capd") AND event.duration IS NOT NULL AND @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend | STATS p95_ns = PERCENTILE(event.duration, 95) BY event.action | EVAL p95_ms = p95_ns / 1000000 | RENAME event.action AS action | SORT p95_ms DESC | LIMIT 12
